posts.title: Taking Mario Kart 64 to Silverstone
posts.description: I built Silverstone as a Mario Kart 64 course with GPT 6.1 Sol in Codex cloud environments, then used Max Verstappen’s pole lap onboard to shape the scenery, corner by corner.

posts.title: Mario Kart 64 on My Phone: Giving the Agent a Test Drive
posts.description: I brought Mario Kart 64 to my phone with WebAssembly, lighter textures and Tour-inspired controls, then gave the coding agent a way to test its changes before I played them myself.

posts.title: About
posts.description: Hey there! I’m Edd 👋🏻, a Lead Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience. I build reliable, evolvable systems in TypeScript, PHP, and Python - leaning on DDD, event sourcing, the AWS Serverless stack (Lambda, CDK, Fargate, EventBridge), and Terraform. Currently building end-to-end systems for the UK railway signalling sector - from ESP32 telemetry firmware over cellular GPRS through to AWS-nat
